prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished original character design for a Chinese animated-fantasy game: Bifang, the mythological one-legged bird. The direction is majestic mythology with deadpan, slightly absurd comedy, expressed through the character's silhouette, face and posture. This must read as a deliberate 2D animated character, not realistic concept art, a photographic animal, CGI, or a baby mascot.

Subject: ONE complete bird, three-quarter side view facing LEFT. A crane-inspired Bifang with exactly ONE long leg and ONE taloned foot in total; there is no second leg, including tucked or hidden legs. Preserve a blue-green/teal body, clearly readable cinnabar-red feather markings and an ivory-white beak. Exaggerate the sweeping S-curved neck, heavy proud chest, expressive head and large simplified wing shapes. The single foot plants firmly and plausibly supports the body. Keep it a formidable mythic opponent, not a cute pet.

Expression and pose: a pompous, indignant, slightly aggrieved expression, as if a powerful creature is being unfairly blamed and stubbornly denying everything. Heavy half-lowered eyelids, a sharply raised feather brow and a tense beak make the expression funny but still dignified. Half-open wings form an elbows-out, offended mantle posture, but they remain anatomically bird wings, without human arms or hands. Humor comes only from the expression and body language. No clothes, glasses, cigarettes, modern props, weapons or gag accessories.

Art direction: confident flowing contours, strong readable silhouette, bold teal/red/ivory color masses, two- or three-step cel shading and only restrained hand-painted accents. Simplify feathers into a few elegant layered groups; do not render individual photorealistic feather fibers, noisy surface textures or cinematic realism. Bright, clear character lighting. Make the facial expression legible even when reduced to gameplay scale. No purple or magenta on the character.

Composition and background: full-body portrait character sheet with ONE pose only. The entire beak, both wings, tail, single leg and foot must stay inside the frame, with generous empty margins of about ten percent. Background is perfectly flat saturated magenta, RGB 255,0,255, for later local chroma-key removal. No gradients, magenta reflected light, ground, cast shadow, scenery, smoke, sparks, fire, magical effects, motion blur, UI, text, labels, border, watermark or additional creatures. Finish as a sharp high-resolution illustration.
